content: niriWayle second desktop: niri + Wayle shell (0.7.0) + Veila lock (0.4.4) + Raffi launcher (0.24.0, native iced) + oo7 secrets (Alpine). aports 49fa80d+f040ebc+6934607 (wayle/veila/raffi/wl-clipboard-rs/upower-dinit/wayle-session). Installer niri_wayle.go + rules niriWayle + users.go + harness split. Session gotchas: wayle shell foreground (panel start daemonizes), wayle-shell-session env wrapper (WAYLAND_DISPLAY/NIRI_SOCKET). Validated: niriWayle dinit 2026-10-15T22-40-19Z 97/97; niri regression 98/98.

niriWayle DE reuses the niri session infra (turnstile + per-user dinit on both inits): Wayle/Veila daemons as per-user dinit services; wayle-session package owns the session script + niriwayle.desktop + depends niri-user-dinit. Stasis deferred to v2 (veila daemon idle covers lock-on-idle + before-sleep). oo7 replaces gnome-keyring in niriWayle only.
